text:
```artifact
@startuml
actor Patient
actor Doctor
actor Chemist
actor Lab
actor Admin

participant "Consultation System" as CS
participant "Prescription System" as PS
participant "Pharmacy System" as PH
participant "Lab System" as LS

== Test Case TC-001: Patient generates a consultation request and Doctor gives diagnosis ==
Patient -> CS: Generate Consultation Request
CS -> Doctor: Notify Consultation Request
Doctor -> CS: Provide Diagnosis
CS -> Patient: Send Diagnosis

== Test Case TC-002: Prescription is sent to Patient, Chemist, and Labs ==
Doctor -> PS: Generate Prescription
PS -> Patient: Send Prescription
PS -> Chemist: Send Prescription
PS -> Lab: Send Prescription

== Test Case TC-003: Chemist delivers medicines to Patient ==
Chemist -> PH: Receive Prescription
PH -> Patient: Deliver Medicines

== Test Case TC-004: Labs collect specimen and deliver lab report to Patient ==
Lab -> LS: Receive Prescription
LS -> Patient: Collect Specimen
LS -> Patient: Deliver Lab Report
LS -> CS: Update Lab Report

== Test Case TC-005: Admin sets up specialties ==
Admin -> CS: Set Up Specialties

== Test Case TC-006: Admin adds doctors ==
Admin -> CS: Add Doctors

== Test Case TC-007: Admin adds labs and pharmacy ==
Admin -> CS: Add Labs and Pharmacy

== Test Case TC-008: Admin edits doctors information ==
Admin -> CS: Edit Doctors Information

== Test Case TC-009: Negative - Patient fails to generate consultation request ==
Patient -> CS: Generate Consultation Request
alt Failure
    CS -> Patient: Request Failed
else Success
    CS -> Doctor: Notify Consultation Request
end

== Test Case TC-010: Negative - Doctor fails to provide diagnosis ==
Doctor -> CS: Provide Diagnosis
alt Failure
    CS -> Doctor: Diagnosis Failed
else Success
    CS -> Patient: Send Diagnosis
end

== Test Case TC-011: Negative - Prescription fails to be sent to Patient ==
Doctor -> PS: Generate Prescription
alt Failure
    PS -> Doctor: Prescription Failed
else Success
    PS -> Patient: Send Prescription
end

== Test Case TC-012: Negative - Chemist fails to deliver medicines to Patient ==
Chemist -> PH: Receive Prescription
alt Failure
    PH -> Chemist: Delivery Failed
else Success
    PH -> Patient: Deliver Medicines
end

== Test Case TC-013: Negative - Labs fail to collect specimen from Patient ==
Lab -> LS: Receive Prescription
alt Failure
    LS -> Lab: Collection Failed
else Success
    LS -> Patient: Collect Specimen
end

== Test Case TC-014: Negative - Admin fails to set up specialties ==
Admin -> CS: Set Up Specialties
alt Failure
    CS -> Admin: Setup Failed
else Success
    CS -> Admin: Setup Successful
end

== Test Case TC-015: Negative - Admin fails to add doctors ==
Admin -> CS: Add Doctors
alt Failure
    CS -> Admin: Addition Failed
else Success
    CS -> Admin: Addition Successful
end

== Test Case TC-016: Negative - Admin fails to add labs and pharmacy ==
Admin -> CS: Add Labs and Pharmacy
alt Failure
    CS -> Admin: Addition Failed
else Success
    CS -> Admin: Addition Successful
end

== Test Case TC-017: Negative - Admin fails to edit doctors information ==
Admin -> CS: Edit Doctors Information
alt Failure
    CS -> Admin: Edit Failed
else Success
    CS -> Admin: Edit Successful
end
@enduml
```
